# nirvana_storage_keys (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nirvana_storage_keys" "example_storage_keys" {
  project_id = "project_id"
  name = "name"
  region = "region"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project ID of resources to request

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `name` (String) Filter by a case-insensitive substring of the Object Storage Key name
- `region` (String) Filter by region
- `sort` (String) Comma-separated sort terms in precedence order, each field:asc or field:desc. Fields: created_at, updated_at, name

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `access_key` (String) S3 access key ID.
- `created_at` (String) When the Object Storage Key was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Object Storage Key.
- `name` (String) Name of the Object Storage Key.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID the Object Storage Key belongs to.
- `region` (String) Region the resource is in.
Available values: "us-sva-2", "us-wdc-1".
- `status` (String) Status of the resource.
Available values: "pending", "creating", "updating", "ready", "deleting", "deleted", "error", "suspended".
- `updated_at` (String) When the Object Storage Key was updated.
